semantics.evidence: problem.txt: all sequential logic positive edge; active high synchronous reset to 12:00 AM; reset higher priority than enable
semantics.reset: At each rising edge with reset=1 set pm=0, hh=0x12, mm=ss=0, independent of ena
semantics.enable: With reset=0 and ena=1 increment exactly one second at that edge; otherwise hold
semantics.rollover: Seconds and minutes wrap 59 to 00. Hours advance 01 through 12 then 01. Toggle pm on 11:59:59 to 12:00:00 only
semantics.latency: Outputs reflect the new registered clock after the same edge, no extra stages
semantics.initialization: Power-up state unspecified; no initial assignments; verification establishes state by reset

numeric.encoding: Unsigned packed BCD: tens in bits 7:4, units in bits 3:0

verification.oracle: Independent integer elapsed-second model modulo 86400 derived from original clock semantics
verification.sampling: Drive reset and ena at falling edges, check hold before rising edge and outputs after NBA at rising edge +1 time unit
verification.coverage: Reset with ena low/high, disabled hold, full 24-hour cycle, all BCD carries and hour/AM/PM boundaries, bursty enables, reset during operation
verification.failure: $fatal on any mismatch and bounded timeout; PASS only after all checks

specification_ambiguities.evidence: Original problem specifies reset state but no initial or invalid-state behavior
specification_ambiguities.resolution: Do not impose power-up values or invalid-state recovery requirements; check legal reachable states after reset
